customManagers.description: Devcontainer Dockerfile ARG pins annotated with renovate comments
Workflow tool pins — `version:`, `<tool>-version:` (e.g. setup-node's node-version) and `wranglerVersion:` styles
Workflow/composite-action and script tool pins, `FOO_VERSION=x.y.z` shell-variable style
Taskfile tool pins (root Taskfile + included taskfiles/), `FOO_VERSION: x.y.z` var style

Composite-action tool pins — a bare `version:` (setup-task) or a `<tool>-version:`/`<tool>_version:` input (setup-node, setup-tflint). The workflow manager above only looks at .github/workflows, so without this manager every pin in .github/actions/ is invisible to Renovate and silently frozen.

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before proposing any update
Batch all GitHub Actions updates into one PR
Batch regex-managed workflow and composite-action updates into one PR — the composite action provisions the same CI toolchain the workflows do, so its pins belong in the same batch

Eject anthropics/claude-code-action from the batched GitHub Actions group and skip the 3-day release-age wait. It ships near-daily first-party releases, so grouping + minimumReleaseAge kept the whole Actions batch perpetually pending on the renovate/stability-days gate. Must come after the GitHub Actions group rules so this override wins.
Batch all Docker image updates into one PR

Batch all devcontainer updates (base image + annotated tools) into one PR — must come after the Docker images rule so the base image lands here instead. The devcontainer-coupled scripts are listed explicitly (NOT scripts/** — that would couple unrelated pins like markdownlint-cli2 and pip-audit to this batch): the devcontainer CLI wrappers, plus run-semgrep.sh because semgrep is pinned in both the Dockerfile and that script and must move in one PR
